name: note-webhook
title: Note to webhook
description: Sends short notes to a webhook: one for each finished request (an observer hook), and any note a chat asks for (a tool).

hooks.name: finished
hooks.description: a note for each finished request: its id, model, tokens and time

tools.name: send_note
tools.description: Send a short note to the team's webhook.

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_TOKEN
secrets.description: sent as the bearer when it is set

url.description: where the notes go: a host the plugin may reach (its network: capability)

on_finished.description: a note for each finished request

timeout_s.description: how long a post may take
